voice.rooms.description: The name of the list of the open voice chat rooms on the rooms' screen, for assistive technology.

voice.rooms_loading.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込んでいます…
voice.rooms_loading.description: In place of the list of voice chat rooms while the first of them load.

voice.rooms_failed.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込めませんでした。
voice.rooms_failed.description: In place of the list of voice chat rooms when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

voice.rooms_empty.defaultMessage: いま開いているルームはありません。
voice.rooms_empty.description: In place of the list of voice chat rooms when none is open that the reader sees.

voice.back.description: The back button at the top of a voice chat room's page, which leads to the list of rooms.

voice.loading.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込んでいます…
voice.loading.description: In place of a voice chat room while it loads.

voice.failed.defaultMessage: ルームを読み込めませんでした。
voice.failed.description: In place of a voice chat room when it could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

voice.retry.description: The button after a voice chat room's or a list's failure to load that loads it again.

voice.hosted_by.description: Under a voice chat room's title on its page: who hosts it ({host}, a display name).

voice.speakers.description: The heading of the participants of a voice chat room who may speak (the host, the co-hosts, the speakers), and the name of their list.

voice.listeners.description: The heading of the participants of a voice chat room who listen, and the name of their list.

voice.no_listeners.defaultMessage: まだ聞き手はいません。
voice.no_listeners.description: Under the heading Listeners of a voice chat room while it has none.

voice.role_host.description: Under a participant's name in a voice chat room: they host it.

voice.role_cohost.description: Under a participant's name in a voice chat room: they are a co-host.

voice.speaking.description: Said of a participant of a voice chat room while they speak, for assistive technology; their avatar is ringed.

voice.mic_off.description: Said of a speaker of a voice chat room whose microphone is off; a crossed-out microphone on their avatar.

voice.hand.description: Said of a participant of a voice chat room who raised a hand to speak; a hand on their avatar.

voice.blocked.description: Under the name of a participant of a voice chat room whom the reader blocks or who blocks the reader; they are shown, marked, and their reactions are hidden.

voice.join_note.defaultMessage: 参加すると、このルームが見える人全員に、参加者の一覧であなたの名前が表示されます。
voice.join_note.description: Over the Join button of a voice chat room the reader is not in: what joining shows of them.

voice.join_moves.defaultMessage: 参加すると「{room}」から退出します。
voice.join_moves.description: Over the Join button of a voice chat room while the reader is in another one ({room}, its name): one can be in one room at a time.

voice.join_full.defaultMessage: ルームが満員です。人数が減ってから、もう一度試してください。
voice.join_full.description: After pressing Join (409 voice-room-full), when the voice chat room holds as many people as its maximum allows, or more after the maximum was lowered.

voice.over_max.defaultMessage: {reader, select, host {ルームの人数が、あなたが設定した上限の {max} 人を超えています。退出させられた人はいませんが、{max} 人より少なくなるまで新しい人は参加できません。新しい人がすぐ参加できるようにするには、「ルームの設定」で上限を上げてください。} other {ルームの人数が上限の {max} 人を超えています。退出させられた人はいませんが、{max} 人より少なくなるまで新しい人は参加できません。}}
voice.over_max.description: A notice on a voice chat room's page while it holds more people than its maximum ({max}, a number), after the maximum was lowered: reader is host (the host, while the room's maximum is the one the host set; Room settings is the item of the room's menu) or other (everyone else, and the host when the server's lower maximum applies).

voice.join_hosting.defaultMessage: 別のルームのホストです。そのルームを終了するか、ホストを渡してから参加してください。
voice.join_hosting.description: After pressing Join, when the reader hosts another open voice chat room.

voice.join.description: The button that joins the reader to a voice chat room, as a listener.

voice.join_unavailable.defaultMessage: このブラウザーでは、このページで通話を使えません。このサーバーのアドレスを https:// で開くか、別のブラウザーを使ってください。
voice.join_unavailable.description: After pressing Join, when the browser gives the page no microphone or sound: the page is not served over HTTPS, or the browser does not support it.

voice.join_failed.defaultMessage: ルームに参加できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.join_failed.description: After pressing Join, when joining failed for any other reason.

voice.connecting.description: In a voice chat room the reader joined, until its connection is up.

voice.reconnecting.defaultMessage: 接続が切れました。再接続しています…
voice.reconnecting.description: In a voice chat room the reader is in, while its connection is down and comes back by itself.

voice.muted_by.defaultMessage: {name} があなたのマイクをオフにしました。もう一度オンにできます。
voice.muted_by.description: In a voice chat room the reader speaks in, after a host or a co-host ({name}, their display name) muted the reader.

voice.muted_by_someone.defaultMessage: ホストがあなたのマイクをオフにしました。もう一度オンにできます。
voice.muted_by_someone.description: In a voice chat room the reader speaks in, after a host or co-host who is no longer listed muted the reader.

voice.mic_failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, denied {ブラウザーがマイクを使えません。サイトの設定で許可してから、もう一度試してください。} missing {マイクが見つかりません。つないでから、もう一度試してください。} busy {ほかのアプリがマイクを使っています。そのアプリを閉じてから、もう一度試してください。} refused {このルームの話者ではなくなりました。もう一度話すには、「挙手」か「話す」を使ってください。} other {マイクをオンにできませんでした。もう一度試してください。}}
voice.mic_failed.description: In a voice chat room, when the reader's microphone could not be turned on: the browser refused it ({reason} denied), there is none (missing), another app holds it (busy), the reader is a listener again and the server did not let them speak (refused; Raise hand and Speak are the controls that ask to speak), or anything else (other).

voice.hear_room.description: The button in a voice chat room, and in the call's bar, while the browser holds the room's sound back until the reader presses something: pressing it plays the sound.

voice.hear_held.defaultMessage: ブラウザーがルームの音声を止めています。
voice.hear_held.description: Beside the Hear the room button in a voice chat room, while the browser holds its sound back until a press.

voice.controls.description: The name of the toolbar of a voice chat room's controls (the microphone, the hand, reactions, leaving), for assistive technology.

voice.mute.description: The microphone's control in a voice chat room while it is on: pressing it turns it off.

voice.unmute.description: The microphone's control in a voice chat room while it is off: pressing it turns it on.

voice.speak.description: The control of a listener of a voice chat room who may speak without asking: pressing it makes them a speaker.

voice.listen.description: The control of a speaker of a voice chat room that makes them a listener again.

voice.raise_hand.description: The control of a listener of a voice chat room who may not speak without asking: pressing it asks the hosts to let them speak.

voice.lower_hand.description: The control of a listener of a voice chat room whose hand is raised: pressing it takes the request back.

voice.react.description: The control of a voice chat room that opens the emoji picker to send a reaction, which everyone in the room sees for a moment.

voice.leave.description: The control of a voice chat room that leaves it.

voice.act_failed.defaultMessage: {action, select, speak {話し始める操作} listen {話すのをやめる操作} raise {挙手} lower {挙手の取り下げ} leave {退出} end {ルームの終了} other {リアクション}}を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.act_failed.description: In a voice chat room, when the server refused or did not answer what the reader pressed: action is which of them (speak, listen to stop speaking, raise or lower the hand, leave, end: the host ending the room, or other: sending a reaction).

voice.end_room.description: The button beside the notice that the host must choose before leaving: it ends the voice chat room for everyone.

voice.output.description: The name of the choice, in a voice chat room, of the speakers or headphones the room's sound plays on.

voice.output_default.description: The first choice of the sound output in a voice chat room: the device's default speakers.

voice.output_unnamed.description: A choice of the sound output in a voice chat room whose device the browser does not name until the site may use the microphone ({number}, its place in the list).

voice.end.defaultMessage: {kind, select, removed {{reason, select, removed {ホストがあなたを「{room}」から退出させました。このルームにはもう参加できません。} blocked {ブロックのため「{room}」から退出しました。} suspended {アカウントが凍結されたため「{room}」から退出しました。} disconnected {接続が切れたため「{room}」から退出しました。} other {「{room}」から退出しました。}}} replaced {別の端末で「{room}」に参加したため、この端末では退出しました。} ended {{reason, select, host {ホストが「{room}」を終了しました。} moderator {モデレーターが「{room}」を終了しました。} time_limit {「{room}」は時間の上限に達して終了しました。} disabled {このサーバーで通話が無効になったため、「{room}」は終了しました。} host_disconnected {ホストの接続が切れたため、「{room}」は終了しました。} other {「{room}」は終了しました。}}} lost {「{room}」への接続が切れました。} other {「{room}」の音声が使えなくなったため、退出しました。}}
voice.end.description: Why the reader is no longer in the voice chat room {room} (its name), on its page and in a toast on the other screens: {kind} removed (with {reason}: removed by a host, blocked, suspended, disconnected), replaced (joined on another device), ended (with {reason}: why the room ended), lost (the server dropped the session), or other (the sound failed).

voice.end_close.description: The button at the end of the toast that says why the reader is no longer in a voice chat room.

voice.ended.defaultMessage: このルームは終了しました。
voice.ended.description: On the page of a voice chat room that ended, under its name when the server shows it.

voice.unavailable.defaultMessage: このルームは開いていないか、あなたには見えません。
voice.unavailable.description: On the page of a voice chat room the reader does not see: it never was, or it is not shown to them.

voice.local_only.defaultMessage: このサーバーにアカウントがある人だけが、ルームに参加できます。
voice.local_only.description: On the page of a voice chat room for a visitor who is not signed in, beside the sign-in button.

voice.open_now.description: On a voice chat room's page for a visitor, while the room is open and the server shows its summary.

voice.off.defaultMessage: このサーバーでは通話を使えません。
voice.off.description: On a voice chat page while the server has voice chat turned off.

voice.open_hosted_by.description: On a voice chat room's page for a visitor, under its name, while the room is open and the server shows its summary with its host ({host}, a display name).

voice.end_open.description: The action of the toast that says why the reader is no longer in a voice chat room: it opens the room's page, which says it again.

voice.self.description: Under the name on the reader's own tile among the participants of a voice chat room: the tile is theirs. A line of its own, which a long name never cuts.

voice.sign_in_join.description: The button on a voice chat room's page for a visitor who is not signed in: the sign-in, which comes back to the room, where they can join it.

voice.open.description: Over the list of voice chat rooms, the button that leads to the form that opens one; and the title of that form.

voice.open.submit.description: The button at the foot of the form that opens a voice chat room: it opens the room and joins the reader to it as its host.

voice.open.not_allowed.defaultMessage: このサーバーではルームを開けません。誰が開けるかはサーバーの管理者が決めます。
voice.open.not_allowed.description: In place of the form that opens a voice chat room, for a reader who may not open rooms.

voice.form.name.description: The label of the field of a voice chat room's name, in the form that opens a room or changes its settings.

voice.form.name_empty.defaultMessage: ルームの名前を入れてください。
voice.form.name_empty.description: Under the name field of a voice chat room's form, when the reader sends it with no name.

voice.form.name_rule.defaultMessage: 名前は 1 行で 1〜100 文字です。
voice.form.name_rule.description: Under the name field of a voice chat room's form, when the server refused the name without saying why.

voice.form.icon.description: The heading of the choice of the emoji shown before a voice chat room's name, in the room's form; also the name of that group for assistive technology.

voice.form.icon_choose.description: The button that opens the emoji picker to choose a voice chat room's icon, while it has none; also the picker's name.

voice.form.icon_change.description: The button that opens the emoji picker to choose another icon for a voice chat room, beside the one chosen; also the picker's name.

voice.form.icon_remove.description: Beside the icon chosen for a voice chat room, the button that leaves the room without one.

voice.form.icon_rule.defaultMessage: アイコンは絵文字 1 つか、このサーバーのカスタム絵文字です。
voice.form.icon_rule.description: Under the icon of a voice chat room's form, when the server refused the icon without saying why.

voice.form.description.description: The label of the field of a voice chat room's description, in the room's form.

voice.form.description_rule.defaultMessage: 説明は 500 文字までです。
voice.form.description_rule.description: Under the description field of a voice chat room's form, when the server refused it without saying why.

voice.form.hashtags.description: The label of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags, in the room's form.

voice.form.hashtags_hint.defaultMessage: 5 つまで、スペースで区切ります。
voice.form.hashtags_hint.description: Under the label of the hashtags field of a voice chat room's form: how many and how to write them.

voice.form.hashtags_rule.defaultMessage: ハッシュタグは 5 つまで、スペースで区切ります。
voice.form.hashtags_rule.description: Under the hashtags field of a voice chat room's form, when it holds more than 5 or the server refused them.

voice.form.visibility.description: The heading of the choice of who sees a voice chat room, in the room's form; also the choice's name.

voice.form.visibility_choice.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, local {このサーバーの全員} followers {あなたのフォロワー} following {あなたがフォローしている人} mutuals {相互フォローの人} other {招待された人だけ}}
voice.form.visibility_choice.description: An option of who sees a voice chat room: visibility is local, followers, following, mutuals, or other (invited: only the people the host or a co-host invites).

voice.form.speakers.description: The heading of the choice of who may speak in a voice chat room without raising a hand, in the room's form; also the choice's name.

voice.form.speakers_choice.defaultMessage: {speakers, select, everyone {参加した全員} followers {あなたのフォロワー} following {あなたがフォローしている人} mutuals {相互フォローの人} other {許可された人だけ}}
voice.form.speakers_choice.description: An option of who speaks in a voice chat room without asking: speakers is everyone, followers, following, mutuals, or other (manual: only the people the host or a co-host lets speak).

voice.form.max_participants.description: The label of the number field of the most people a voice chat room holds at once, in the form that opens a room and in its settings; also named in the field's errors.

voice.form.max_participants_hint.defaultMessage: 2〜{max} 人。空欄のときは、このサーバーの上限の {max} 人です。
voice.form.max_participants_hint.description: Under the label of the field How many can be in the room of a voice chat room's form: the range, and what an empty field means ({max}, the server's maximum of the people in a room, a number).

voice.form.max_participants_rule.defaultMessage: 参加できる人数には 2〜{max} の数を入れるか、空欄にしてください。
voice.form.max_participants_rule.description: Under the field How many can be in the room of a voice chat room's form, when the form or the server (422, field max_participants) refused the number: below 2 or above {max}, the server's maximum of the people in a room.

voice.form.max_participants_unavailable.defaultMessage: いまはサーバーにその人数分の空きがないため、設定を保存しませんでした。参加できる人数を減らすか、しばらくしてからもう一度試してください。
voice.form.max_participants_unavailable.description: Under the field How many can be in the room of an open voice chat room's settings, when the host raised the number and the server answered 503: it has no space for that many people now. A number no larger than the room's current maximum is always saved.

voice.form.post.description: The heading of the post that tells that a voice chat room opened, in the form that opens a room.

voice.form.post_check.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, local {ルームを開いたことをこのサーバーに投稿する} other {ルームを開いたことをフォロワーに投稿する}}
voice.form.post_check.description: The checkbox of the start post in the form that opens a voice chat room: visibility is local (a post for this server) or other (followers: a post for the reader's followers).

voice.form.post_text.description: The label of the text of the start post in the form that opens a voice chat room.

voice.form.post_draft.defaultMessage: 通話のルーム「{name}」を開きました。
voice.form.post_draft.description: The text the start post of a voice chat room starts with, which the reader may change: name is the room's name as written.

voice.form.post_link.defaultMessage: 投稿の末尾にルームへのリンクが付きます。
voice.form.post_link.description: Under the text of the start post of a voice chat room.

voice.form.post_refused.defaultMessage: 投稿できなかったため、ルームは開きませんでした。本文を変えるか、投稿せずに開いてください。
voice.form.post_refused.description: Under the text of the start post when the server refused the post without saying why.

voice.form.not_sent.defaultMessage: 印の付いた項目を直して、もう一度試してください。
voice.form.not_sent.description: Before the button of a voice chat room's form, when the form or the server found something wrong with a field.

voice.form.open_refused.defaultMessage: {kind, select, not_eligible {このサーバーではルームを開けません。} too_many_rooms {このサーバーで開けるルームの数に達しています。しばらくしてからもう一度試してください。} other {別のルームのホストです。そのルームを終了するか、ホストを渡してから開いてください。}}
voice.form.open_refused.description: Before the button of the form that opens a voice chat room, when the server refused it: kind is not_eligible (the reader may not open rooms), too_many_rooms (the server's limit), or other (the reader hosts another open room).

voice.form.failed.defaultMessage: 送信できませんでした。接続を確認して、もう一度試してください。
voice.form.failed.description: Before the button of a voice chat room's form, when the server could not be reached or failed.

voice.form.post_without.defaultMessage: 投稿せずに開くには、開始の投稿のチェックを外してください。
voice.form.post_without.description: Under the text of the start post of a voice chat room, after what the server said of a post it refused: the way to open the room anyway.

voice.settings.title.description: The title of the form that changes an open voice chat room's settings, and the item of the room's menu that leads to it.

voice.settings.submit.description: The button at the foot of the form that changes an open voice chat room's settings.

voice.settings.host_only.defaultMessage: ルームの設定を変えられるのはホストの {host} だけです。
voice.settings.host_only.description: In place of a voice chat room's settings, for a reader who is not its host: host is the host's name.

voice.settings.ended.defaultMessage: このルームは終わったため、設定と招待もなくなりました。
voice.settings.ended.description: In place of a voice chat room's settings or invitations, when the room ended.

voice.settings.end_heading.description: The heading of the last part of a voice chat room's settings, which ends the room for everyone.

voice.room_back.description: The back button of a screen under a voice chat room (its settings, its invitations), which leads to the room.

voice.host.op.defaultMessage: {op, select, grant {話せるようにする} dismiss {挙手を断る} revoke {聞き手にする} mute {マイクをオフにする} remove {ルームから退出させる…} cohost {共同ホストにする} uncohost {共同ホストから外す} other {ホストにする…}}
voice.host.op.description: An item of the menu a host or co-host opens on a participant of a voice chat room: op is grant (lets them speak, also the answer to a raised hand), dismiss (turns the raised hand down), revoke (makes a speaker a listener), mute (turns their microphone off), remove (takes them out for good, asked first), cohost, uncohost, or other (hand_over: makes them the host, asked first).

voice.host.menu.description: The name of the menu a host or co-host opens on a participant of a voice chat room: name is the participant's.

voice.host.cohosts_full.defaultMessage: 共同ホストは {count, plural, other {# 人}}までです。
voice.host.cohosts_full.description: Under Make co-host in a participant's menu, when the room has as many co-hosts as it can: count is that number.

voice.host.failed.defaultMessage: {cause, select, cohosts {共同ホストはこれ以上増やせません。先に誰かを外してください。} next_host {{name} はルームのホストになれません。別の人を選んでください。} other {{op, select, grant {{name} を話せるようにする操作} dismiss {{name} の挙手の却下} revoke {{name} を聞き手にする操作} mute {{name} のマイクをオフにする操作} remove {{name} の退出} cohost {{name} を共同ホストにする操作} uncohost {{name} を共同ホストから外す操作} other {{name} をホストにする操作}}を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。}}
voice.host.failed.description: In a voice chat room, when what a host or co-host did to a participant was refused or did not finish: cause is cohosts (too many co-hosts), next_host (the participant may not host rooms), or other, which names the operation op (grant, dismiss, revoke, mute, remove, cohost, uncohost, or other: hand_over); name is the participant's.

voice.host.cancel.description: The button that closes a dialog of a voice chat room's host (removing someone, handing over, ending, leaving) without doing it.

voice.host.ask_title.defaultMessage: {op, select, remove {{name} をルームから退出させますか？} other {{name} をホストにしますか？}}
voice.host.ask_title.description: The question of the dialog before removing a participant of a voice chat room (op remove) or handing the room over to them (other): name is the participant's.

voice.host.ask_text.defaultMessage: {op, select, remove {退出させた人はこのルームに再び参加できません。} other {あなたはルームに残ります。この後は {name} がルームを運営し、終えることもできます。}}
voice.host.ask_text.description: What follows removing a participant (op remove) or handing the room over to them (other), in its dialog: name is the participant's.

voice.host.ask_confirm.defaultMessage: {op, select, remove {退出させる} other {ホストにする}}
voice.host.ask_confirm.description: The button that confirms removing a participant of a voice chat room (op remove) or handing the room over to them (other).

voice.host.room_menu.description: The name of the menu at the top of a voice chat room's page, for its host and co-hosts: its settings, its invitations, ending it.

voice.host.end.description: An item of a voice chat room's menu, for its host: ends the room for everyone, asked first.

voice.host.end_title.defaultMessage: ルームを終了しますか？
voice.host.end_title.description: The question of the dialog before the host ends a voice chat room.

voice.host.end_text.defaultMessage: 参加している全員が退出します。取り消せません。
voice.host.end_text.description: What follows ending a voice chat room, in its dialog.

voice.host.done.defaultMessage: {op, select, remove {{name} をルームから退出させました。} other {{name} がルームのホストになりました。}}
voice.host.done.description: Said in a voice chat room once the host removed a participant (op remove) or handed the room over to them (other: hand_over): name is the participant's.

voice.leave_dialog.title.defaultMessage: 次は誰がホストをしますか？
voice.leave_dialog.title.description: The title of the dialog that opens when the host of a voice chat room leaves it while others are in it; also the name of its choice.

voice.leave_dialog.text.defaultMessage: ルームにはまだ人がいます。誰かにホストを渡すか、ルームを終了してください。
voice.leave_dialog.text.description: Under the title of the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room while others are in it.

voice.leave_dialog.next.defaultMessage: {cohost, select, yes {共同ホストの {name} に渡す} other {{name} に渡す}}
voice.leave_dialog.next.description: An option of the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room: makes the participant name the host; cohost is yes for a co-host, else other.

voice.leave_dialog.end.description: The last option of the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room: ends the room instead of handing it over.

voice.leave_dialog.confirm.description: The button of the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room, while a next host is chosen.

voice.leave_dialog.end_confirm.description: The button of the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room, while ending the room is chosen.

voice.leave_dialog.refused.defaultMessage: {name} はルームのホストになれません。別の人を選ぶか、ルームを終えてください。
voice.leave_dialog.refused.description: In the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room, when the server refused the next host chosen: name is theirs.

voice.leave_dialog.failed.defaultMessage: 退出できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.leave_dialog.failed.description: In the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room, when the leave did not finish.

voice.leave_dialog.gone.defaultMessage: {name} はルームから退出しました。別の人を選ぶか、ルームを終えてください。
voice.leave_dialog.gone.description: In the dialog of a host who leaves a voice chat room, when the participant they chose as the next host left meanwhile: name is theirs.

voice.invitations.title.description: The title of the screen of a voice chat room's invitations, the heading of their list, its name, and the item of the room's menu that leads to it.

voice.invitations.loading.defaultMessage: 招待を読み込んでいます…
voice.invitations.loading.description: In place of the invitations of a voice chat room while they load.

voice.invitations.failed.defaultMessage: 招待を読み込めませんでした。
voice.invitations.failed.description: In place of the invitations of a voice chat room when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

voice.invitations.none.defaultMessage: まだ誰も招待していません。
voice.invitations.none.description: In place of the invitations of a voice chat room while there are none.

voice.invitations.as.defaultMessage: {role, select, speaker {話者として招待} other {聞き手として招待}}
voice.invitations.as.description: Beside an account in the invitations of a voice chat room: role is speaker or other (listener).

voice.invitations.revoke.description: The button that revokes an invitation to a voice chat room, beside the account invited.

voice.invitations.revoked.defaultMessage: {name} への招待を取り消しました。
voice.invitations.revoked.description: Said on the invitations screen of a voice chat room after the reader revoked one: name is the account's.

voice.invitations.revoke_failed.defaultMessage: {name} への招待を取り消せませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.invitations.revoke_failed.description: Said on the invitations screen of a voice chat room when a revocation did not finish: name is the account's.

voice.invitations.hosts_only.defaultMessage: ルームに招待できるのはホストと共同ホストだけです。
voice.invitations.hosts_only.description: In place of a voice chat room's invitations, for a reader who is neither its host nor a co-host.

voice.invite.heading.description: The heading of the part of a voice chat room's invitations screen that finds people and invites them.

voice.invite.search.description: The label of the field that finds people to invite to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.search_hint.defaultMessage: 招待できるのはこのサーバーの人だけです。
voice.invite.search_hint.description: Under the label of the field that finds people to invite to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.clear.description: The button that empties the field that finds people to invite to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.role.description: The name of the choice of as what people are invited to a voice chat room, for assistive technology.

voice.invite.role_choice.defaultMessage: {role, select, speaker {話者として (許可なしで話せます)} other {聞き手として}}
voice.invite.role_choice.description: An option of as what people are invited to a voice chat room: role is speaker or other (listener).

voice.invite.searching.description: In place of the people found to invite to a voice chat room while the search runs.

voice.invite.search_failed.defaultMessage: 検索を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
voice.invite.search_failed.description: In place of the people found to invite to a voice chat room when the search failed.

voice.invite.none_found.defaultMessage: このサーバーに一致する人はいません。
voice.invite.none_found.description: In place of the people found to invite to a voice chat room when the search found none.

voice.invite.found.description: The name of the list of people found to invite to a voice chat room, for assistive technology.

voice.invite.invite.description: The button beside an account found that invites it to a voice chat room.

voice.invite.invited.description: In place of Invite beside an account found that is invited to the voice chat room already.

voice.invite.done.defaultMessage: {role, select, speaker {{name} を話者として招待しました。} other {{name} を聞き手として招待しました。}}
voice.invite.done.description: Said on the invitations screen of a voice chat room after an invitation: name is the account's, role speaker or other (listener).

voice.invite.refused.defaultMessage: {kind, select, already_invited {{name} はこのルームに招待されたことがあります。同じルームに招待できるのは 1 回だけです。} invalid_invitee {{name} はこのルームに招待できません。} rate_limited {このルームから今送れる招待の数に達しました。しばらくしてからもう一度試してください。} other {{name} を招待できませんでした。もう一度試してください。}}
voice.invite.refused.description: Said on the invitations screen of a voice chat room when an invitation was refused: kind is already_invited (once per room, also after a revocation), invalid_invitee (a block between them and a host, removed from the room, not an active local account), rate_limited, or other; name is the account's.
